verses.en: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.
verses.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

verses.en: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’
verses.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ

verses.en: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––
verses.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

verses.en: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

verses.en: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:
verses.ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

verses.en: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,
verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ

verses.en: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts
verses.ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ

verses.en: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’
verses.ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

verses.en: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,
verses.ar: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

verses.en: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’
verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ

verses.en: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,
verses.ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ

verses.en: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.
verses.ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ

verses.en: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails
verses.ar: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ

verses.en: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.
verses.ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

verses.en: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?
verses.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

verses.en: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.en: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

verses.en: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.en: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;
verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ

verses.en: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.
verses.ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ

verses.en: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.en: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

verses.en: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:
verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

verses.en: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!
verses.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

verses.en: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’
verses.ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ

verses.en: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,
verses.ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

verses.en: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.
verses.ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ

verses.en: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’
verses.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ

verses.en: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.
verses.ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

verses.en: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.en: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.
verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ

verses.en: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

verses.en: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

verses.en: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn
verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ

verses.en: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.
verses.ar: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

verses.en: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

verses.en: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.en: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

verses.en: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’
verses.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

verses.en: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

verses.en: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

verses.en: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.
verses.ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

verses.en: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’
verses.ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

verses.en: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?
verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ

verses.en: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.
verses.ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

verses.en: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:
verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

verses.en: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––
verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

verses.en: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’
verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

verses.en: We have created all things in due measure;
verses.ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ

verses.en: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;
verses.ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

verses.en: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

verses.en: Everything they do is noted in their records:
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

verses.en: every action, great or small, is recorded.
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

verses.en: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,
verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ

verses.en: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.
verses.ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
